title: Department
description: The tag in each of a venture's department folders (EE-047): which department the folder is and where it sits in the value chain. It lives in the folder at <layer>/departments/<id>/department.json, or under an optional grouping folder, <layer>/departments/primary/<id>/ or support/<id>/, which is for looking at only; the tag, not the folder, says what the department is. Its values must match operations/departments.json.

owner.description: The role that heads it, from the roles register
